docs.summary: Provides physics collision for terrain using heightmap-based collision detection. Samples height data directly from the TerrainData asset (no separate cache).

The grid placement, refreshed from the transform once per frame rather than read per query. The broad phase samples this from Jitter's worker threads, and Transform's cached world matrix is not safe to touch concurrently; caching also keeps the per-sample height lookup off it entirely.

The grid is defined in terrain-local space, so position, rotation and scale all live in these matrices rather than being baked into the samples. That is what lets terrain be turned to any orientation and still collide correctly.
